summary: The Agent Market performance chain has one archived production browser-to-public-Evidence sample, and the project-specific AWS consumer was reversibly paused after readback.

proof.proves: A controlled browser event produced request_id 38979d29-2ef6-4006-b120-6cc95e59eef4 and run_id 44c41841-3d20-4856-9f71-76750075c3a4.
The performance work queue accepted and drained the sample workload.
The one-time ECS cleaner run exited successfully for the archived sample.
The aggregate readback reported sampleCount 1, LCP 1192 ms, and errorRate 0.
The public Evidence page exposes the delivery and performance status without exposing credentials.
The project-specific AWS consumer was paused reversibly after verification; DLQ/queue state was inspected during shutdown.

limitations: The verified sample count is one; treat it as delivery evidence, not an ongoing production SLO.
The AWS consumer is paused after verification; new samples require an explicitly authorized controlled run.
nextStep: For a new release, run a fresh preview or production Web Vitals smoke after Cloudflare deployment and record it separately without overwriting the archived sample.
